annotations.title: Household electricity or gas from the values on a bill

description: An indicative calculation (verified: false, with estimate_note like compare_energy). Pass the values from the household's electricity or gas bill (as read by POST /api/v1/digital/energy/bill, by yourself from the document, or typed by a person) and get the same ranked answer as compare_energy: yearly totals of every priced offer for that distributor area, rate and breaker, with the saving against the bill's own prices (saving_basis: own_prices) or against the monthly advance. Consumption of a billed period other than a year is scaled to 365 days by period_days. Confirm the values with the person before calling; nothing is stored.

distributor.description: cez-distribuce | egd | pre-distribuce | gasnet | gas-distribution | ppd

locale.description: Language of estimate_note: cs | sk | en (default en).

monthly_advance.description: Monthly advance with VAT (used when the prices are missing).

nt_mwh.description: Low-tariff consumption in MWh in the billed period.

nt_price_mwh.description: Supplier's low-tariff price per MWh without VAT.

vt_mwh.description: Consumption in MWh in the billed period: high tariff or all (gas: all).

vt_price_mwh.description: Supplier's commodity price per MWh without VAT.

name: compare_energy_from_bill
title: Household electricity or gas from the values on a bill
